descriptions.tsonnet_b34_probe_800de75c: Builds two three-float vectors from global float constants, calls the unrecovered query 0x800b0824 with 999 and 1, and when the small-data result word is at most 998 copies a small-data word pair into the object at offsets 176 and 180 and returns 1, else 0; field meanings are inferred.
